notes.title: FREE BETA-TEST
notes.content:
[h1]This game is a [b]BETA-TEST[/b] with a [i][u][b]TEMPORARY[/b][/u][/i] web-based UI.[/h1]

Play for free now at: [b][url=http://starforce.hotepgames.com]http://starforce.hotepgames.com[/url][/b]

As a beta-tester, please provide constructive feedback about the gameplay (playability, victory conditions, missions, etc..., [u]not the UI[/u]) on [u][b]my forum[/b][/u]: [b][url=http://forum.hotepgames.com]http://forum.hotepgames.com[/url][/b]

Once 20 or more players have provided constructive feedback on [u][b]my forum[/b][/u], I will create the final, 3d-Graphical UI for the game (not web-based).

Everyone who provided constructive feedback will receive a free copy of the final game.
